title: 第5章 想要我留下可以，求我！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 见到唐逸重新拾起柴刀，所有人脸色都变了。“混账东西，你想干什么？”唐敬脸色难看，挡在了唐画面前：“我已经处置过了王嬷嬷，你别太过分了？”“处置？你那也叫处置？”唐逸淡淡扫了一眼唐敬：“今日，我便教教唐侍郎，处置这三个字，怎么写。”然而，就这么简单的一瞥，唐敬竟然从他的眼神中，看到了难以掩饰的嘲讽和锐利。这是以前在唐逸身上从未看到过的。这让他有了那么一瞬间的失神。而在他失神的瞬间，唐逸直接掠过他，一把将唐画拽了出来。同时，一脚将唐浩踹翻在地。“唐逸，你想干什么？你敢！”唐画吓得面色煞白，惶恐大叫。唐逸没和他们半点废话，在唐敬惊恐瞪大的瞳孔中，唰唰就是两刀。刀劈在唐画和唐画的手臂上，两人手臂当场鲜血淋漓。“啊！”唐画和唐浩的惨叫声传遍全场，看得众人头皮发麻。而唐逸一手脚踩着唐画，一手掐住唐画的脖子，左手拎着染血的柴刀，此时的他俨如魔王降世，威慑全场。唐敬看着这一幕，当场就被震住了。以前，唐逸别说质疑他，就连抬头看他的勇气都没有。现在，唐逸竟然因为不满他的处理，就当着他的面行凶。唐画和唐浩也是差点被吓尿了，刚才还以为唐逸没有证据，不敢拿他们怎么样。却没想到唐逸根本不讲证据，柴刀就霍霍砍了过来。唐音一双大眼睛瞪得溜圆，手中的罐子差点就掉在地上了。这真是我哥哥吗？我哥哥啥时候这么强了？“爹，爹，救我，救我啊！”唐浩吓哭了，嚎着求救。唐敬回过神，盯着唐逸的目光冰冷如刀：“唐逸，放开画儿和浩儿，竟敢对自己兄长动手？你是疯了吗？！”“再不放开，就别怪我心狠了。”唐画是他辛苦培养的接班人，绝不允许出现任何意外。哪怕是亲儿子，也不能对唐画产生任何威胁。“怎么，唐侍郎，心疼了？”唐逸只觉得嘲讽，唐音满身伤站在这里，唐敬连问都没问一句。现在，却对唐画和唐浩充满关心！他轻笑一声，一脚将唐画踹跪在地上，盯着唐敬道：“唐侍郎别那么着急，等下你还有更心疼的。”“他们怎么对待我妹妹的，我就得怎么样讨回来。”“你不爽，没关系，等下咱们细聊，现在，你先边上看着。”唐逸冲着唐音招了招手，唐音抹了一把眼角的泪水，立即笑着向着唐逸跑过去。太好了，我哥终于站起来了呢。“哥哥，给你。”唐音揭开罐盖，扬起脑袋将瓷器递给唐逸。然后，唐敬和唐家兄弟，就看到唐逸伸手进罐子中，抓出了一大把白花花的盐出来。见到这一幕，唐敬脸色剧变，唐画和唐浩当场吓得直哆嗦。“爹，爹，救命，救命啊！”“唐逸，有话好好说，别乱来，你别乱来。”唐画和唐浩虽然不知道伤口撒盐有多疼，但他们曾经见过，唐音被他们洒了盐后，小小的身体满地打滚。那肯定很疼！而当时，他们就笑嘻嘻地站在一旁，将她当球一般踢来踢去。“唐逸，你敢！”“你……你敢动他们，我便将你逐出唐家，从唐家除名。”唐敬怒火中烧，眼底隐隐有杀意，唐画是他所有的希望，还要参加殿试，绝对不能毁在唐逸的手中。“哦？这样么？求之不得呢！”“唐家而已，真以为我很稀奇这个身份？”唐逸抬手，一把盐直接覆盖在唐画和唐浩的伤口上，随即松开了两人。“啊！”顷刻间，唐画和唐浩疼得满地打滚，凄厉的惨叫响彻整个唐家。唐音有些害怕，下意识抓紧了唐逸的衣角，却从唐逸的腿侧，露出小脑袋仔细看着这一幕。当初她也是这样疼得直打滚，但唐画和唐浩没有理他，现在哥哥帮她报仇了。“好，好得很，孽障，我竟没想到，唐家最狠戾怨毒的是你！”唐敬看着这一幕脸色冰冷至极，作为吏部侍郎，几乎所有人见到他都低眉顺眼，没有人敢违抗他的命令。现在，他的亲儿子竟然视他为无物。“来人，给我拿下他！”唐敬一挥手，十几个家丁立即围了过来。“呵！”唐逸将唐音抱起来，捡起了地上的柴刀。柴刀指着唐敬，唐逸笑容冷冽：“唐侍郎这叫什么话，我是在教你处置两个字，就得这么写。”“还有，不用你赶，我和唐音现在就离开唐家。”“从此，我们和唐家，再无半点瓜葛。”“当然，唐侍郎想要强行留住我们也可以……”唐逸转了转手中的柴刀，声音沉沉：“前提是，唐侍郎已经做好了唐家血流成河的准备……”唐敬听到这话，心头顿时直发毛。少年脸色平静，但不知为何唐敬觉得，真强行动手将唐逸留下来，他真的会杀人。最重要的是，刚才他说将唐逸赶出家门，完全是在威胁而已。唐逸和唐音现在苦兮兮，连乞丐都不如，现在真让他出去，外人会怎么看他？恐怕当年宠妾灭妻的事，会再度被人提起，重新将他推上风口浪尖。到时候，不说他的仕途，也必然会影响到唐画的殿试。只要唐画能三元及第，搁谁家不是天大的荣耀？到时候，谁还敢说他宠妻灭妾？只会说他英明睿智，慧眼识人。这可是洗刷以前耻辱的大好机会，绝对不能让唐逸破坏了！“爹，不能让他走，爹，杀了他，杀了他啊！”唐浩暴跳如雷，恨意滔天。“二弟说得没错！不能让唐逸出去，否则这等奸诈小人，必然会坏我唐家名声，坏父亲名声。”唐画疼得冷汗直冒，死死盯着唐逸，目光阴冷狠戾。此时也恨不得亲手动手杀了唐逸，以泄心头之恨。“逆子，你给我站住。”唐敬抬头看向抱着唐音往外走的唐逸，冷喝：“你现在立即带着唐音给我滚回去，今日的事，我不和你计较。”“敢出唐家一步，我必定打断你的腿！”唐逸一听，当即停下脚步。他转身看向唐敬，笑容满面：“想要我们兄妹留下来？那你们这态度可不行。”“这样吧，我也不为难你们。”“你们父子给我道歉，求着我们兄妹留下来，记住了，是求我们！”“那我们兄妹，可以勉为其难留下来。”听到这话，唐浩和唐画顿时目瞪口呆。我们是这个意思吗？我们不是这个意思。我们说不能让你离开，是要让父亲杀了你，谁说是求你？唐敬脸色也是阴沉下来，混账东西，我是你爹！要我求你？你承受得起吗？“唐侍郎，我只给你三息时间考虑！”唐逸竖起三根指头，强硬开口。“三！”“二！”……
content_en: Seeing Tang Yi pick up the hatchet again, everyone's expressions changed."Bastard, what do you want to do?" Tang Jing looked ugly and stood in front of Tang Picture: "I have already dealt with Grandma Wang, don't go too far?" "Disposal? You also call that disposal?" Tang Yi glanced at Tang Jing lightly: "Today, I will teach Mr. Tang how to write the three words "disposal." However, with such a simple glance, Tang Jing saw the irony and sharpness in his eyes that could not be concealed.This has never been seen in Tang Yi before.This made him lose consciousness for a moment.The moment he lost consciousness, Tang Yi passed over him and pulled Tang Hua out.At the same time, he kicked Tang Hao to the ground."Tang Yi, what do you want to do? How dare you!" Tang Hua turned pale with fright and shouted in panic.Tang Yi didn't talk nonsense to them. In Tang Jing's frightened pupils, there were two swish of swords.The knife hit Tang Hua and Tang Hua's arms, and their arms were dripping with blood on the spot."Ah!" Tang Hua and Tang Hao's screams spread throughout the audience, making everyone's scalp numb.Tang Yi stepped on Tang Hua with one hand and held Tang Hua's neck with one hand, and held the blood-stained hatchet with his left hand. At this time, he was like a devil coming to the world, intimidating the entire audience.Tang Jing looked at this scene and was shocked on the spot.In the past, Tang Yi didn't even have the courage to look up at him, let alone question him.Now, Tang Yi actually committed murder in front of him because he was dissatisfied with his handling.Tang Hua and Tang Hao were almost scared to death. They thought Tang Yi had no evidence and didn't dare to do anything to them.But he didn't expect that Tang Yi didn't give any evidence at all, and the hatchet came fiercely.Tang Yin's big eyes widened and he almost dropped the jar in his hand.Is this really my brother?When did my brother become so strong?"Dad, dad, save me, save me!" Tang Hao cried in fright, howling for help.Tang Jing came back to his senses and stared at Tang Yi with a gaze as cold as a knife: "Tang Yi, let go of Hua'er and Hao'er, how dare you attack your brother? Are you crazy?!" "If you don't let go, don't blame me for being cruel." Tang Hua is the successor he trained so hard, and no accidents are allowed.Even his biological son cannot pose any threat to Tang Hua."Why, Minister Tang, are you feeling distressed?" Tang Yi only felt ridiculed. Tang Yin was standing here with wounds all over his body. Tang Jing didn't even ask a question.Now, he is full of concern for Tang Hua and Tang Hao!He chuckled lightly, kicked Tang Hua to the ground, stared at Tang Jing and said, "Don't be so anxious, Mr. Tang, you will feel more sorry for me later." "I will get back whatever they do to my sister." "It doesn't matter if you are unhappy. We will talk about it later. Now, you just watch from the side." Tang Yi waved to Tang Yin, who wiped the tears from his eyes and immediately ran towards Tang Yi with a smile.Great, my brother finally stood up."Brother, here you go." Tang Yin opened the lid of the jar, raised his head and handed the porcelain to Tang Yi.Then, Tang Jing and the Tang brothers saw Tang Yi reaching into the jar and grabbing a large handful of white salt.Seeing this scene, Tang Jing's expression changed drastically, and Tang Hua and Tang Hao trembled with fear on the spot."Dad, dad, help, help!" "Tang Yi, if you have something to say, please say it. Don't mess around. Don't mess around." Although Tang Hua and Tang Hao didn't know how painful it was to rub salt into a wound, they had seen Tang Yin's little body rolling on the ground after they sprinkled salt on it.That must have hurt!At that time, they stood aside with smiles and kicked her around like a ball."Tang Yi, how dare you!" "You... if you dare to touch them, I will expel you from the Tang family and remove you from the Tang family." Tang Jing was furious, with murderous intent faintly in his eyes. Tang Hua was all his hope, and he had to participate in the palace examination. He must not be ruined in Tang Yi's hands."Oh? Is that so? I couldn't ask for it!" "It's just the Tang family, do you really think I'm curious about this identity?" Tang Yi raised his hand, covered the wounds of Tang Hua and Tang Hao with a handful of salt, and then let go of the two of them."Ah!" In an instant, Tang Hua and Tang Hao were rolling on the ground in pain, and their shrill screams resounded throughout the Tang family.Tang Yin was a little scared, and subconsciously grabbed the corner of Tang Yi's clothes, but she exposed her little head from the side of Tang Yi's legs and watched the scene carefully.She was also writhing in pain like this at first, but Tang Hua and Tang Hao ignored him, and now her brother helped her take revenge."Okay, great, evildoer, I didn't expect that you are the most vicious and vicious person in the Tang family!" Tang Jing looked at this scene with an extremely cold face. As the Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, almost everyone looked down upon him and no one dared to disobey his orders.Now, his biological son actually regards him as nothing."Come here, take him down for me!" Tang Jing waved his hand, and a dozen servants immediately surrounded him."Ha!" Tang Yi picked up Tang Yin and picked up the hatchet on the ground.Pointing at Tang Jing with the hatchet, Tang Yi smiled coldly: "What do you call this, Minister Tang? I'm teaching you how to handle two words. You have to write it like this." "Also, you don't need to rush me. Tang Yin and I will leave the Tang family now." "From now on, there will be no difference between us and the Tang family.Ge.""Of course, Tang Shilang can force us to stay..." Tang Yi turned the hatchet in his hand and said in a deep voice: "The premise is that Tang Shilang is already prepared for the Tang family to bleed..." When Tang Jing heard this, his heart suddenly went numb.The young man's face was calm, but for some reason Tang Jing felt that if he really forced Tang Yi to stay, he would really know how to kill.The most important thing is that when he said he would drive Tang Yi out of the house just now, he was just threatening.Tang Yi and Tang Yin are now so miserable that they are worse than beggars. If they are allowed to go out now, what will outsiders think of them?I'm afraid that the incident of doting on his concubine and destroying his wife will be brought up again, putting him at the forefront of the limelight again.At that time, not to mention his official career, it will inevitably affect Tang Hua's imperial examination.As long as Tang Dynasty painting can reach the third place, which family will not have a great honor?At that time, who would dare to say that he dotes on his wife and kills his concubines?I can only say that he is wise and wise, and has a keen eye for knowing people.This is a great opportunity to wash away the previous shame, and Tang Yi must not be allowed to destroy it!"Father, don't let him go. Dad, kill him, kill him!" Tang Hao was furious and filled with hatred."Second brother is right! Don't let Tang Yi go out, otherwise such a treacherous villain will definitely ruin the reputation of my Tang family and my father." Tang Hua was so painful that he broke into a cold sweat and stared at Tang Yi with cold and cruel eyes.At this moment, he wished he could kill Tang Yi himself to vent his hatred."Sir, stop here." Tang Jing raised his head and looked at Tang Yi, who was holding Tang Yin and walking out.
title_en: Chapter 5 If you want me to stay, you can, please!
